Confirmed: `com.google.common.cache.LocalCache` (guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java) is the class built by `CacheBuilder` that holds cache entries, and it has a nested `Segment` class that partitions entries into independently-locked segments (the same striped-locking design as the old `ConcurrentHashMap`).

ANSWER: `LocalCache` (com.google.common.cache.LocalCache, guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java) holds the cache entries; its nested class `LocalCache.Segment` splits them into separately locked segments.
